Do-Si-Do with Dodrio (Japanese: VS ドードリオ VS ), titled Dodrio, Watchout! in the Chuang Yi translation, is the 140th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 50th chapter of the .

==Plot==
 
Lt. Surge boards his submarine and goes underwater. He then finds Silver's Gyarados . He wonders whether it being frozen is linked to the appearance of many Gyarados three weeks prior. The Gyarados suddenly breaks the ice and begins to chase Lt. Surge's submarine. Lt. Surge sends out his and has it charge the submarine's laser beam. Before he can fire, Silver's Gyarados swims ahead of the submarine and tries to release something else that is frozen. However, it soon collapses from fatigue. Lt. Surge, believing the to be frozen inside, destroys the ice with the ship's laser beam and retrieves what was frozen, which turns out to be Gold's shoe, goggles, hat, and backpack, as well as Silver's shoe. Inside Gold's backpack, he finds Gold's Pokédex.

Meanwhile, in Olivine City, 's Pokédex and Poké Balls have been repaired. She plans to go to next by boat because none of her Pokémon can learn . Seeing her Pokémon's despondence, she encourages them. Crystal then sees a pair of (Pika and Chuchu) Surfing. She decides to try to capture them (because most Pikachu cannot learn Surf). Suddenly, Chuchu is thrown into the air. appears on and catches Chuchu. Yellow then realizes Crystal's identity and tells her that she has been looking for her.

==Major events==
Lt. Surge finds Silver's Gyarados and 's belongings, and takes them with him.
